license_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice or to offer to practice as a registered nurse in this state unless that person has been licensed under this chapter or holds a valid multistate license under chapter 18.80 RCW.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Washington state board of nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the Washington state board of nursing.

type.quote: It is the purpose of the state board of nursing to regulate the competency and quality of professional health care providers under its jurisdiction

age_minimum.quote: Written official evidence that the applicant is over the age of eighteen

degree_required.value: Graduation from an approved nursing education program
degree_required.quote: An official transcript demonstrating graduation and successful completion of an approved program of nursing

accrediting_body.quote: The board shall approve curricula and shall establish criteria for minimum standards for schools preparing persons for licensing as registered nurses, advanced registered nurse practitioners, and licensed practical nurses under this chapter.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Applicants must pass an examination in subjects determined by the board; multistate license applicants must pass NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN® or NCLEX-PN® examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

required.quote: The board shall adopt rules on continuing competency.

available.quote: Upon approval of the application by the board, the department shall issue a license by endorsement without examination to practice as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse to a person who is licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or possession of the United States

requirements.value: Must be licensed in another state/territory and meet all other qualifications for licensing; foreign graduates must meet all qualifications and pass examinations
requirements.quote: who meets all other qualifications for licensing. An applicant who has graduated from a school or program of nursing outside the United States and is licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, or their equivalents, outside the United States must meet all qualifications required by this chapter and pass examinations as determined by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice or to offer to practice as a registered nurse in this state unless that person has been licensed under this chapter or holds a valid multistate license under chapter 18.80 RCW.

credential_type.quote: the department shall issue a license to practice registered nursing, advanced registered nursing, or licensed practical nursing, as appropriate

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice or to offer to practice as a registered nurse in this state unless that person has been licensed under this chapter or holds a valid multistate license under chapter 18.80 RCW.

title_protection.quote: No other person may assume those titles or use the abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs, or figures to indicate that the person using them is a registered nurse.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice or to offer to practice as a registered nurse in this state unless that person has been licensed under this chapter or holds a valid multistate license under chapter 18.80 RCW.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined in RCW 18.130.180
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not having engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined in RCW 18.130.180 or being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety as defined in RCW 18.130.170.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing without a license or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Uniform Disciplinary Act, chapter 18.130 RCW, governs unlicensed practice, the issuance and denial of licenses, and the discipline of licensees under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety as defined in RCW 18.130.170

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement of material fact in an application for license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or with reason to know made a false statement of a material fact (a) in an application for license or any data attached thereto, or (b) in any matter under investigation by the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with a child support order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend the license of a person who has been certified pursuant to RCW 74.20A.320 by the department of social and health services, division of [child] support, as a person who is not in compliance with a child support order

definition_quote.value: "Registered nursing practice" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of the biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in either: (a) The observation, assessment, diagnosis, care or counsel, and health teaching of individuals with illnesses, injuries, or disabilities, or in the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others; (b) The performance of such additional acts requiring education and training and that are recognized by the medical and nursing professions as proper and recognized by the board to be performed by registered nurses licensed under this chapter and that are authorized by the board through its rules; (c) The administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice...; (d) The teaching of nursing; (e) The executing of medical regimen as prescribed by a licensed physician and surgeon, dentist, osteopathic physician and surgeon, podiatric physician and surgeon, physician assistant, or advanced registered nurse practitioner...
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing practice" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of the biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences

value: observation, assessment, diagnosis, care or counsel, and health teaching
administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
executing medical regimen as prescribed by authorized practitioners
administering medications, treatments, tests, and inoculations

methods_authorized.quote: The observation, assessment, diagnosis, care or counsel, and health teaching of individuals with illnesses, injuries, or disabilities, or in the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others

drug_authority.value: Advanced registered nurse practitioners may prescribe legend drugs and Schedule V controlled substances, and Schedules II through IV subject to board approval and scope of practice
drug_authority.quote: Upon approval by the board, an advanced registered nurse practitioner may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances contained in Schedule V of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, chapter 69.50 RCW, and Schedules II through IV subject to RCW 18.79.240(1) (r) or (s).

value: Advanced Registered Nurse Practitioner (ARNP) / Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
license_tiers.quote: It is unlawful for a person to practice or to offer to practice as a registered nurse... as an advanced registered nurse practitioner or as a nurse practitioner... as a licensed practical nurse in this state unless that person has been licensed under this chapter

value: Advanced Registered Nurse Practitioner (ARNP) / Nurse Practitioner (NP)
aprn_role_categories.quote: advanced registered nurse practitioners, approved by the board as certified registered nurse anesthetists from selecting, ordering, or administering controlled substances

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: under the direction of a licensed physician and surgeon, osteopathic physician and surgeon, dentist, naturopathic physician, podiatric physician and surgeon, physician assistant, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or midwife acting under the scope of his or her license, or at the direction and under the supervision of a registered nurse

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: "Advanced registered nursing practice" means the performance of the acts of a registered nurse and the performance of an expanded role in providing health care services as recognized by the medical and nursing professions, the scope of which is defined by rule by the board.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced registered nurse practitioner under his or her license may perform for compensation nursing care, as that term is usually understood, of the ill, injured, or infirm

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Upon approval by the board, an advanced registered nurse practitioner may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances

value: Schedule II (with board approval and scope of practice)
Schedule III (with board approval and scope of practice)
Schedule IV (with board approval and scope of practice)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances contained in Schedule V of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, chapter 69.50 RCW, and Schedules II through IV subject to RCW 18.79.240(1) (r) or (s) within the scope of practice defined by the board

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Board must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs, including dosing criteria requiring consultation with pain management specialist above certain thresholds; APRNs must inform patients of right to refuse opioid prescription
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: By January 1, 2019, the board must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs. The rules may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The registration of nursing assistants and providing for voluntary certification of those who wish to seek higher levels of qualification is in the interest of the public health, safety, and welfare.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication assistant" means a nursing assistant-certified with a medication assistant endorsement issued under RCW 18.88A.082 who is authorized, in addition to his or her duties as a nursing assistant-certified, to administer certain medications and perform certain treatments in a nursing home under the supervision of a registered nurse

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A registered nurse may delegate tasks of nursing care to other individuals where the registered nurse determines that it is in the best interest of the patient.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Nursing homes shall report to the board of nursing, within 30 days of employment, all nurses holding a multistate license issued by a state other than Washington and an attestation that the employees holding a multistate license issued by a state other than Washington have completed the tasks required under this section as a condition of employment.

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: No person may coerce a nurse into compromising patient safety by requiring the nurse to delegate if the nurse determines that it is inappropriate to do so. Nurses shall not be subject to any employer reprisal or disciplinary action by the board for refusing to delegate tasks or refusing to provide the required training for delegation if the nurse determines delegation may compromise patient safety.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A person seeking to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse in this state may choose to apply for a license issued under this chapter or a multistate license issued under chapter 18.80 RCW.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A person seeking to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse in this state may choose to apply for a license issued under this chapter or a multistate license issued under chapter 18.80 RCW.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: the board shall establish a stipend program to defray the out-of-pocket expenses incurred in connection with participation in the board's approved substance use disorder monitoring program authorized by RCW 18.130.175.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: Prohibiting the determination and pronouncement of death

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: subject to a request for certified registered nurse anesthetist anesthesia services issued by a physician licensed under chapter 18.71 RCW, an osteopathic physician and surgeon licensed under chapter 18.57 RCW, a dentist licensed under chapter 18.32 RCW, or a podiatric physician and surgeon licensed under chapter 18.22 RCW

military_education_credit_required.quote: An applicant with military training or experience satisfies the training or experience requirements of this chapter unless the board determines that the military training or experience is not substantially equivalent to the standards of this state.
